title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ‘Integrated development-humanitarian programme: Climate-proofing agricultural, energy, and food security practices in Luuq, Belet Xawa, Dollow, Garbaharey, and El Wak counties, Gedo region’ programme, implemented by Trócaire, aims to contribute to Outcome 2.1: Poor and marginalised people, especially women and youth, have sustainable lives including diverse food sources and economic well-being. The activities and objective include, NRM and stakeholders trained and supported in advocacy, review of Early Warning Systems and Livelihood Adaptation Options and, sensitisation, training and south-to-south networking of grass roots and civil society so groups are collaborating initiatives for the sustainable management and governance of natural resources nationally and internationally. Programmes are in partnership with, Somali Humanitarian Relief Action and Centre for Research and Integrated Development. ---- The principal focus of this outcome is: - Evidence-based climate change advocacy and networking in the National, regional & international climate justice arenas. - Supporting local voices to advocate for the protection of their natural resources and influencing national and international policy - Climate adaptation is linked to biodiversity because by protecting and restoring biodiversity, we strengthen the resilience of our ecosystems and the communities we work with to the impacts of climate change- Policy work at national and international level on climate finance, support for Agroecology and promotion of renewables are directly linked to climate mitigation
